description: This file defines the TabHelperHoneycomb class, which provides compatibility support for tab management in Android's ActionBar for API level Honeycomb. It offers methods to add tabs, save, and restore state, utilizing Android's ActionBar and FragmentManager.

classes.name: TabHelperHoneycomb
classes.description: A helper class for managing tabs in the ActionBar on Honeycomb. It manages tab creation, state saving/restoring, and interaction with FragmentManager and ActionBar.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActionBar and sets its navigation mode to support tabs.

methods.name: addTab
methods.description: Adds a tab to the ActionBar, manages associated fragment state, and ensures callback presence.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current selected tab position into the provided Bundle.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores the tab position from the saved state and updates the ActionBar accordingly.
